interface_decision.semantic_role: prime-power orbit sizes and the fixed-point congruence for finite p-group actions
interface_decision.litex_form: a prime-power factor induction followed by invariant-subset orbit removal and defect divisibility

proof_spine: Use Euclid's lemma and cancellation inductively to show every nontrivial factor of p^n is divisible by p.
Orbit-stabilizer turns each nontrivial orbit into such a factor.
Remove one orbit from an invariant finite subset and induct on its size.
The total non-fixed-point defect is divisible by p, yielding the fixed-point congruence.

blocks.name: prime_power_factor_property

attempts.verifier_evidence: Literal outer try committed the induction predicate.

blocks.accepted_litex:
prop prime_power_factor_property(p N+, exponent N):
    forall left, right N+:
        $prime(p)
        left * right = p^exponent
        left > 1
        =>:
            $group::divides(p, left)
